mapper.sql: id, fp_id, category, severity, is_first_seen, root_cause, business_impact, impact_note, confidence, locate_confidence, code_snippet, code_ref, trace_chain, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, elapsed_ms, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_inspect_analysis (fp_id, category, severity, is_first_seen, root_cause, business_impact, impact_note, confidence, locate_confidence, code_snippet, code_ref, trace_chain, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, elapsed_ms) VALUES (#{fpId}, #{category}, #{severity}, #{isFirstSeen}, #{rootCause}, #{businessImpact}, #{impactNote}, #{confidence}, #{locateConfidence}, #{codeSnippet}, #{codeRef}, #{traceChain}, #{model}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{elapsedMs})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_inspect_analysis WHERE fp_id = #{fpId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
